facts.fact: The General Information Authority held a consultative meeting with ESCWA, ministries, private-sector and civil-society representatives to review the proposed National Cloud Computing Policy, a unified framework for hosting government data and services, and agreed to incorporate feedback toward its final version; the document gives no date for the event other than its published date of 2026-01-01.

systems.owner: General Information Authority (Libya), with ESCWA as consulting partner
